t: You're standing at the Lodge House to Kenwood House, an eighteenth-century gatehouse marking the entrance to the Kenwood Estate in Hampstead. It was designed by the architect George Saunders, who lived from 1762 to 1839. Gatehouses like this were built to announce an estate and to house the person who watched over the entrance, so this small building is your first look at Kenwood before you reach the main house.
